Frontline: Objective v8.40.0 external CGTrader assets

This build is already wired for the seven requested models. The actual CGTrader model binaries were not present in the supplied v8.39.0 ZIP and therefore are not redistributed here.

Drop downloaded models (plus textures) into the characters/ and weapons/ folders using the filenames in CGTRADER_ASSET_SETUP.md. GLB, FBX and OBJ are recognized; GLB is preferred.
